 Cyclone Akvan

 2 min read
 Tags: Rapid Fire CA 
 Quick Facts For Prelims 
 GS Paper - 1 
 Cyclone 
 GS Paper - 3 
 Disaster Management 
 Source:AIR   
 The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued red and orange alerts along India's eastern coast as Cyclone ‘Akvan’ advances northwestwards over the Bay of Bengal . It marks the third consecutive cyclonic threat in the basin within a month following Cyclones Arnab and Murasu .   
 Cyclone Akvan: A tropical cyclone that originated as a low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal and intensified into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over the west-central Bay of Bengal.   
 Impact and Preparedness: Heavy to very heavy rainfall warnings have been issued across coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, with isolated rainfall in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and Gangetic West Bengal.   
 State governments deployed National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) and Odisha Disaster Rapid Action Force (ODRAF) teams.   
 Nomenclature and Meaning: Iran proposed the name ‘Akvan’ under the World Meteorological Organisation/United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (WMO/ESCAP) Panel on Tropical Cyclones (PTC) .    
 Akvan is derived from Akvan Div , a mythical demon-like giant featured in the Persian epic Shahnameh , authored by the poet Ferdowsi.
